scripts.daily: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),zlib=require('zlib'); if(fs.existsSync('prices.db.gz')){fs.writeFileSync('prices.db',zlib.gunzipSync(fs.readFileSync('prices.db.gz')))}" && node optimize_db.js && node scraper.js --mode=daily && node optimize_db.js && node compress_db.js
scripts.weekly: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),zlib=require('zlib'); if(fs.existsSync('prices.db.gz')){fs.writeFileSync('prices.db',zlib.gunzipSync(fs.readFileSync('prices.db.gz')))}" && node optimize_db.js && node scraper.js --mode=weekly && node optimize_db.js && node compress_db.js
scripts.daily:parallel: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),zlib=require('zlib'); if(fs.existsSync('prices.db.gz')){fs.writeFileSync('prices.db',zlib.gunzipSync(fs.readFileSync('prices.db.gz')))}" && node optimize_db.js && npm run scrape:daily:segments && node merge_db.js && node optimize_db.js && node compress_db.js
scripts.weekly:parallel: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),zlib=require('zlib'); if(fs.existsSync('prices.db.gz')){fs.writeFileSync('prices.db',zlib.gunzipSync(fs.readFileSync('prices.db.gz')))}" && node optimize_db.js && npm run scrape:weekly:segments && node merge_db.js && node optimize_db.js && node compress_db.js
scripts.scrape:daily:segments: for /L %i in (1,1,8) do start /wait node scraper.js --mode=daily --segments=8 --segment=%i
scripts.scrape:weekly:segments: for /L %i in (1,1,8) do start /wait node scraper.js --mode=weekly --segments=8 --segment=%i
